keyword.zh: 柴油50和柴油60混凝土泵的区别

title.zh: 柴油50和柴油60混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Both print a 6105 engine line and 30 MPa. Diesel 50 prints 99 kW and 30 m³/h. Diesel 60 prints 144 kW and 35 m³/h.
description.zh: 两边都印 6105 发动机行和 30 MPa。柴油50为 99 kW、30 m³/h。柴油60为 144 kW、35 m³/h。

h1.zh: 柴油50和柴油60混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Diesel 50 and Diesel 60 are separate concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Both print the engine code 6105 and outlet pressure 30 MPa. Diesel 50 prints 99 kW, 30 m³/h and distance 150 m / 450 m. Diesel 60 prints 144 kW, 35 m³/h, distance 150 m / 350 m and the model line Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132. The shared code 6105 does not make the kilowatts equal.
directAnswer.zh: 柴油50和柴油60是河北品锦机械在邢台的两台混凝土泵。两边都印发动机代号 6105 和出口压力 30 MPa。柴油50印 99 kW、30 m³/h、距离 150 m / 450 m。柴油60印 144 kW、35 m³/h、距离 150 m / 350 m，型号行为柴油60 / HBT60-13.132。相同的 6105 不等于千瓦数相同。

heading.en: Where Diesel 50 and Diesel 60 print different values
heading.zh: 柴油50和柴油60哪些数值不同

body.en: Diesel engine power: Diesel 50 prints 6105 / 99 kW; Diesel 60 prints 6105 / 144 kW. Theoretical output: Diesel 50 prints 30 m³/h; Diesel 60 prints 35 m³/h. Pumping distance (H / V): Diesel 50 prints 150 m / 450 m; Diesel 60 prints 150 m / 350 m. Hydraulic pump: Diesel 50 prints Kawasaki 140; Diesel 60 prints Kawasaki double pump 100. Dimensions: Diesel 50 prints 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm; Diesel 60 prints 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm. Main unit weight: Diesel 50 prints 3300 kg; Diesel 60 prints 3500 kg. The same printed value on a shared label: Max. outlet pressure is 30 MPa on both pages; Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³ on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 柴油机功率：柴油50印 6105 / 99 kW；柴油60印 6105 / 144 kW。理论输送量：柴油50印 30 m³/h；柴油60印 35 m³/h。输送距离（水平/垂直）：柴油50印 150 m / 450 m；柴油60印 150 m / 350 m。液压泵：柴油50印 Kawasaki 140；柴油60印 Kawasaki double pump 100。外形尺寸：柴油50印 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm；柴油60印 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm。整机重量：柴油50印 3300 kg；柴油60印 3500 kg。同一标题下数值相同的有：最大出口压力两边都是 30 MPa；料斗容积两边都是 0.4 m³。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Diesel 60 prints cells that Diesel 50 does not: Model line Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 柴油60有、柴油50没有的行：型号行 Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: Read the kilowatt beside 6105. The code alone is not the power. Open /en/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 50 and /en/products/diesel-60-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 60. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 要读 6105 旁边的千瓦。代号本身不是功率。看柴油50请打开 /zh/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/，看柴油60请打开 /zh/products/diesel-60-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Diesel 50 print the same diesel engine power as Diesel 60?
question.zh: 柴油50和柴油60的柴油机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 50 prints 6105 / 99 kW. Diesel 60 prints 6105 / 144 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油50印 6105 / 99 kW。柴油60印 6105 / 144 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Diesel 50 print the same theoretical output as Diesel 60?
question.zh: 柴油50和柴油60的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 50 prints 30 m³/h. Diesel 60 prints 35 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油50印 30 m³/h。柴油60印 35 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Diesel 50 print the same pumping distance (h / v) as Diesel 60?
question.zh: 柴油50和柴油60的输送距离（水平/垂直）一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 50 prints 150 m / 450 m. Diesel 60 prints 150 m / 350 m. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油50印 150 m / 450 m。柴油60印 150 m / 350 m。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Where is the model line for Diesel 60 printed?
question.zh: 柴油60的型号行印在哪里？

answer.en: It is printed on /en/products/diesel-60-concrete-pump/ as Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132. It is not printed as that label on the Diesel 50 page.
answer.zh: 印在 /zh/products/diesel-60-concrete-pump/，数值为 Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132。柴油50页面没有这个标题。
